steps.note: Open the single-stage creation screen specified by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the create screen is valid.
Apply the Buy Template requested by the case.
Verify that the RFQ template was applied before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the product was added to the event.
Open the participant panel on the single-stage create screen.
Verify that the All Vendors window entry is available.
Open the All Vendors window whose locked-add behavior is under test.
Search for the new vendor named in the case.
Submit the vendor search as instructed.
Confirm the search field retained the requested vendor name.
Assert that no vendor-add action is presented while addition is locked.
